platform.cpu: New 6-core CPU with 2 performance and 4 efficiency cores

charging.claim: MagSafe wireless charging up to 25W with 30W adapter or higher; Qi wireless charging up to 7.5W; Fast-charge capable: Up to 50% charge in around 30 minutes with 20W adapter or high

rear_detail: 48MP Fusion: 24mm, ƒ/1.78 aperture, second-generation sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels, support for super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP)
Also enables 12MP 2x Telephoto: 48mm, ƒ/1.78 aperture, second-generation sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels
48MP Ultra Wide: 13mm, ƒ/2.2 aperture and 120° field of view, Hybrid Focus Pixels, super-high-resolution photos (48MP)
12MP 5x Telephoto: 120mm, ƒ/2.8 aperture and 20° field of view, 100% Focus Pixels, seven-element lens, 3D sensor-shift optical image stabilisation and autofocus, tetraprism design
camera.features: 5x optical zoom in, 2x optical zoom out; 10x optical zoom range; Digital zoom up to 25x

connectivity.positioning: Precision dual-frequency GPS (GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, QZSS, BeiDou and NavIC); Digital compass; Wi-Fi; Mobile data
connectivity.sim: Dual SIM (nano-SIM and eSIM); Dual eSIM support

software.policy_note: Apple publishes no fixed upgrade commitment. Recent iPhones have received about six years of major iOS releases plus further security fixes, so the figures here are platform estimates.

specs.sensors: Face ID, LiDAR scanner, Barometer, High dynamic range gyro, High-g accelerometer, Proximity sensor, Dual ambient light sensors
